question: Should pending Skill Workshop approval prompts automatically bind execution to the proposal version described in the prompt?
rationale: Tests establish that the implementation works, but they cannot decide the intentional compatibility policy for proposals revised during an approval wait.

options.title: Bind approval snapshots
options.body: Keep automatic version binding so an older prompt cannot execute proposal content that changed after the prompt was shown.

options.title: Preserve ID-only prompts
options.body: Limit proposal-version binding to explicit review-driven actions and leave generic pending approval prompts unbound.

recommendation.title: Bind approval snapshots
recommendation.body: Keep automatic version binding so an older prompt cannot execute proposal content that changed after the prompt was shown.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and repeatedly hardened Skill Workshop lifecycle behavior and are assigned to this PR.
